chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ al-Ṭāʾī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from ʿImrān ibn Mūsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from his father, from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ al-Ṭāʾī.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author’s immediate source in this chain
key_terms.الطَّائِيِّ: al-Ṭāʾī; the tribal nisbah of ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: al-ʿAṭṭār; an identifying nisbah for Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s mode of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ al-Ṭāʾī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn ʿAwwāḍ al-Ṭāʾī. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission in hadith literature, helping identify how the material in the book reaches this narrator.
